gaps.lead: You should check the timetable before travelling.
gaps.sentence: You ___ check the timetable before travelling.

gaps.lead: The film we saw last week was better than this one.
gaps.sentence: This film is not ___ the one we saw last week.
gaps.explanation: 'Not as good as' expresses an inferior comparison.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: The Minister sat down, and immediately the journalists began shouting.
gaps.sentence: ___ sat down than the journalists began shouting.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had + subject + participle … than' with inversion replaces 'and immediately'.

gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.
